title: Russian Iskander-M Ballistic Missile Kills 6 in Merefa, Kharkiv Oblast — Including Two Teenagers
detail: At approximately 09:35 local time on May 4, Russian forces fired an Iskander-M ballistic missile at the town of Merefa in Kharkiv district. The strike hit a road near residential buildings, damaging outbuildings, shops, a service station, and an administrative building — with more than 10 houses and commercial buildings destroyed or damaged. The death toll rose to 6 killed: victims included three women and two men confirmed dead, among them two teenagers aged 16 and 17. An additional 36 people were wounded, with 3 in critical condition. The Merefa community declared three days of official mourning (May 5–7), signed by Mayor Veniamin Sitov. The strike came as Ukrainian President Zelensky was attending the European Political Community summit in Yerevan, meeting with European leaders to advance diplomatic support for Ukraine's air defense needs — underscoring the disconnect between ongoing diplomacy and Russia's continued civilian strikes.

title: Ukrainian Drone Strikes Luxury Moscow High-Rise 6 km from Kremlin — 5 Days Before Victory Day Parade
detail: Ukrainian drones struck the 'Dom na Mosfilmovskoy' luxury residential complex on Mosfilmovskaya Street in Moscow — approximately 6 km from the Kremlin — on the night of May 3–4. Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin confirmed that 5 drones targeted the capital; 2 were downed before reaching the city, 3 approached the tower. The strike caused visible structural damage to the high-rise building but no reported civilian casualties. The building is located in an elite diplomatic district near embassies and diplomatic residences. The attack comes 5 days before Russia's Victory Day parade (May 9), which Russian authorities had already announced would not feature military vehicles for the first time in approximately 20 years — a concession to security concerns from repeated Ukrainian deep strikes. The strike is one of the deepest confirmed Ukrainian drone attacks into Moscow's residential core. Ukrainian officials did not publicly claim responsibility.

media.caption: Ukrainian drone strikes luxury Moscow high-rise just days before Victory Day parade — visible structural damage to building near Kremlin

title: Zelensky Holds Bilateral Meetings at Yerevan EPC Summit; Washington Format Talks on Ukraine Security
detail: On May 4, President Zelensky continued his participation in the 8th European Political Community summit in Yerevan, Armenia. He held bilateral meetings with the prime ministers of the United Kingdom, Norway, Finland, and Czech Republic, focusing on accelerating weapons deliveries, air defense reinforcement, and implementing the EU's €90 billion loan to Ukraine. A 'Washington Format' meeting was held on the sidelines — a diplomatic mechanism involving Ukraine, European allies, and US envoys to coordinate security guarantees and ceasefire-adjacent discussions. Zelensky used the summit to press allies on providing additional long-range missiles and air defense systems as Russia's drone campaign set wartime records in April 2026. The summit coincided with Russia's continued bombardment of Ukrainian cities, including the Merefa missile strike that killed 6 civilians on the same day, reinforcing Ukraine's argument that diplomacy must be backed by military deterrence.
